products.name: NETGEAR Orbi 970 Series Quad-Band WiFi 7 Mesh System (3-Pack)
products.summary: BE27000 quad-band Wi-Fi 7 mesh system (router + 2 satellites) with a 10 Gig internet port and up to 10,000 sq ft of coverage.
products.description: The Orbi 970 3-Pack (RBE973S) pairs one RBE971 router with two RBE970 satellites for BE27000 quad-band Wi-Fi 7 with NETGEAR's Enhanced Dedicated Backhaul. The router has a 10 Gig internet port, a 10 Gbps LAN port and four 2.5 Gbps LAN ports; each satellite has one 10 Gbps and two 2.5 Gbps ports. NETGEAR rates the system for up to 10,000 sq ft and 200 devices.
products.keywords: orbi 970 rbe973s wifi 7 mesh quad band 10 gig netgear

specs.ports: Router: 1x 10G WAN, 1x 10G LAN, 4x 2.5G LAN; each satellite: 1x 10G, 2x 2.5G

products.priceNote: netgear.com price for the 3-pack; 2-pack $1,499.99; router alone $599.99 (on sale from $799.99).
products.notes: NETGEAR's official product images are only served at ~780 px on a padded canvas (too small after trimming), so the image is omitted.

products.name: Fortinet FortiGate 90G Next-Generation Firewall
products.summary: Desktop FortiGate with 28 Gbps firewall throughput, 2.2 Gbps threat protection, 8x GE and 2x 10GE RJ45/SFP+ shared WAN ports.
products.description: The FortiGate 90G is a desktop next-generation firewall built on Fortinet's SP5 security processor. Its datasheet lists 28 Gbps firewall throughput (1518-byte UDP), 4.5 Gbps IPS and 2.2 Gbps threat protection, with eight GE RJ45 ports and two 10GE RJ45/SFP+ shared-media WAN ports.
products.keywords: fortigate 90g fg-90g fortinet ngfw sd-wan sp5

specs.ports: 8x GE RJ45, 2x 10GE RJ45/SFP+ shared media WAN

products.notes: No manufacturer US list price is published (sold through partners/quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. Hardware-only reference; FortiGuard bundles are extra. No clean official product image could be fetched (only datasheet covers), so image is omitted.

products.name: Cisco Secure Firewall 1220CX
products.summary: Compact Cisco Secure Firewall with 8x 1GbE and 2x 10G SFP+ ports, 9 Gbps firewall and 9 Gbps IPS throughput.
products.description: The Secure Firewall 1220CX is a compact desktop model in Cisco's Secure Firewall 1200 Series for branch offices and small businesses. Cisco's datasheet lists eight 1000BASE-T ports plus two 1/10 Gbps SFP+ ports, 9.0 Gbps firewall throughput and 9.0 Gbps IPS/threat throughput.
products.keywords: cisco secure firewall 1220cx 1200 series ftd asa branch
products.notes: No manufacturer US list price is published (sold through partners/quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. cisco.com blocks automated image downloads, so no image is included.

products.name: Cisco Wireless CW9172I Wi-Fi 7 Access Point
products.summary: Indoor tri-radio Wi-Fi 7 access point with up to 9 Gbps PHY rate and a 2.5G multigigabit uplink.
products.description: The Cisco Wireless 9172I is an entry indoor Wi-Fi 7 access point with 2x2 radios on 2.4, 5 and 6 GHz (or 2x2 2.4 GHz plus 4x4 5 GHz), PHY rates up to 9 Gbps and a 100M/1G/2.5G multigigabit RJ-45 uplink. It runs on 802.3bt Class 5 (32 W), with reduced operation on 802.3at or 802.3af PoE, and is also offered as a Meraki-managed model.
products.keywords: cisco cw9172i wifi 7 meraki catalyst access point
products.notes: No manufacturer US list price is published (sold through partners/quote only); price is a TrustKart estimate. Licensing (Meraki or Cisco Networking subscription) is extra. cisco.com blocks automated image downloads, so no image is included.
